title: Source: the FBI is probing whether the FAA outage was caused by a software update, and doesn't believe it was due to a cyberattack or criminality (Myles Miller/Bloomberg)
summary: Myles Miller / Bloomberg: Source: the FBI is probing whether the FAA outage was caused by a software update, and doesn't believe it was due to a cyberattack or criminality — The Federal Bureau of Investigation doesn't believe the communication issue affecting air traffic control was due to a cyberattack or criminality, said a person familiar with the matter.
